title: Wasn't happy with the currently available selection of dungeon generators so I made one
author: That1guy4226
selftext:
Working on making a complete dungeon builder. the current rooms are really bare and generic but they can be re decorated easily to suit and will save. You can build new rooms to add into the generator. I plan to add a couple of additional types of terrain generation such as forests and villages so that it can be more adaptable to several games. I currently have it setup to export these maps for use in Unity and Godot.

Any thoughts or suggestions are welcome.

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body: If you haven't done it, I suggest you study some  open sourced procedural generated dungeon crawlers. Currently you're missing corridors,  also I don't want to make an assumption, but are all of your rooms currently just squares?

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body: Yeah the rooms are mostly all square currently, this is still the very basic prototypes of the rooms. But creating custom rooms is quite simple and you can designate them by type, and determine how often the generator will use it.

replies.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
replies.body: Are you making the assets? If you are I highly suggest checking out barony, they have some pretty good room generation (it's pretty simple and can totally be improved upon) but they also have really good module level design.

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body: These are actually just the KayKit assets available for free currently. But I'll look into that regardless. I am almost trying to keep it just generic enough that others can use this and adapt it for their own needs. Once I can get this one viable I intend to make a separate version with some higher quality assets

replies.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
replies.body: Also, another question, do you plan on editing topology at all? For things like caves, or dirt-like ground for example. I'm  mainly just tossing suggestions.

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body: There are actually several different wall and floor options that aren't showcased. And I appreciate the engagement. I intend to continue improving this for a little while but wanted to get it out there early to keep myself accountable.

comments.author: PhysicalLevel4260
comments.body: Consider allowing for flagging/marking entrances. So you flag yoh door as an entrance and mark the room on the other side of it to be corridor or room. And then set room size. So you can randomize fully or let it build random dungone rooms. So you can then have corridor and give it options to randomized straight, zigzag, spiral up or down. And then the room designs need stairs to levels. Allow for L shaped rooms and such. This has significant potential. Good luck.

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body: So it does currently allow for L shaped rooms and any other configuration you can reasonably make to be put into the room pool. You can set the frequency certain rooms and such get pulled in the advanced settings. There are a lot of different wall and floor types that aren't currently being shown as well
